title: Why lockdowns are the wrong policy: Swedish expert Prof. Johan Giesecke
summary: UnHerd interview with Swedish epidemiologist Johan Giesecke, who explains why he thinks lockdowns are the wrong policy and describes Sweden's approach during the spring 2020 pandemic.
why: Commenters point to it for the Swedish insider perspective on lockdowns, with some later calling its statements prescient.

quote.text: Here's an interesting interview with a senior epidemiologist partly responsible for Sweden's unconventional strategy
